# Data Architecture & Dictionary — AstroGuide AI

This directory houses the synthetic relational data generated for the customer churn and retention analytics project.

## Directory Structure

* `raw/`: Unmodified synthetic CSV tables generated by `src/generate_data.py`.
* `processed/`: Validated, cleaned, and star-schema analytical tables ready for SQL ingestion and Power BI modeling.

## Relational Tables Overview

| Table Name | File Name | Primary Key | Foreign Keys | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Users** | `users.csv` | `user_id` | - | Customer acquisition, demographics, device, and onboarding metadata. |
| **Activity** | `user_activity.csv` | `event_id` | `user_id` | Granular event stream (horoscope views, tarot readings, AI chat sessions, paywall views). |
| **Subscriptions** | `subscriptions.csv` | `subscription_id` | `user_id` | Subscription plan lifecycle, start/end dates, renewal counts, and cancellation records. |
| **Transactions** | `transactions.csv` | `transaction_id` | `user_id` | Monetization records, recurring billing charges, one-time purchases, refunds, and failed payments. |
| **Churn Labels** | `churn_labels.csv` | `user_id` | `user_id` | Ground-truth churn target label defined strictly over an observation vs. outcome window. |
